channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, EU, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new Writers grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
3 new Writers grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    https://arty-farty.typeform.com/to/xnDikGGM
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No submission fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 5 new Writers grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
5 new Writers grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 20 Jul 2026 (20 Jul to 26 Jul 2026).

  • Comic Creation Grant
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/comic-creation-grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
  • Emerging Authors: Frankfurter Seilschaften
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-authors-frankfurter-seilschaften
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Hotel and travel expenses, per diems, and trade fair passes (amounts not specified). No application fee.
  • Literary Creation Grant
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/literary-creation-grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 25,000 (writing), CHF 18,000 (theatre texts), or CHF 15,000 (performative literary projects). No application fee.
  • Writing in Residency
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/writing-in-residency
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Travel and accommodation costs (vary by destination); childcare support up to CHF 1,000 per month for applicants with caregiving responsibilities. No application fee.
  • International Promotion: Institutions in Switzerland (Literature)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/international-promotion-2
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Writers grants - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
2 new Writers grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 29 Jun 2026 (29 Jun to 05 Jul 2026).

  • Giancarlo DiTrapano Foundation: The Finch Manuscript Lab 2026
    https://ditrapanofoundation.submittable.com/submit/171cc54d-b582-47a3-93a4-47c46b65904b/the-finch-manuscript-lab
    The Giancarlo DiTrapano Foundation for Literature and the Arts · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · EUR 2,280 stipend for the residency period (EUR 30 per day in residence, paid weekly), plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (over 5,000 km), an additional EUR 400 green-travel top-up (e.g. trains instead of planes), and EUR 200 additional support for parents of children under 18. Supported by the Goethe Institute and Culture Moves Europe.
  • NEU Commission 2026
    http://neu-commission.page-not-found.nl/
    Page Not Found · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · EUR 2,000 each to three commissioned writers, paid as an advance in September 2026.

item.title: 3 new Writers grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
3 new Writers grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 11 May 2026 (11 May to 17 May 2026).

  • Nederlands Letterenfonds: Project Grants for Literary Translators (August 2026 round)
    https://www.letterenfonds.nl/en-caribbean/funding/project-grants-for-literary-translators
    Nederlands Letterenfonds (Dutch Foundation for Literature) · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · Project-based subsidy. Income cap EUR 52,500 for primary income. Standard minimum rates: EUR 0.0802/word for prose; EUR 2.92/line for poetry. No application fee.
  • Translation House Looren: Translators' Residencies and Pro Helvetia Stipends 2027
    https://looren.net/en/residencies/application-for-a-stay
    Uebersetzerhaus Looren · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Free residency stay (apartments at the translation house). Six competitive CHF 4,000 translation grants per year, each tied to a one-month residency. Pro Helvetia residency programme separately funded. James Joyce Scholarship and Looren Residency 2027 has its own conditions. No application fee.
  • Nederlands Letterenfonds: Ontwikkelbeurzen voor Literaire Makers (Development Grants)
    https://www.letterenfonds.nl/subsidies/ontwikkelbeurzen-voor-literaire-makers
    Nederlands Letterenfonds (Dutch Foundation for Literature) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 500 to EUR 2,500 per grant. No application fee.
